title: The Corruption of Humanity
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an ancient Israelite marketplace where a succession of ordinary interactions reveals selfishness and moral disorder. One merchant uses false measures, a prosperous landholder refuses to help a needy family, and several men exchange approving looks after spreading a rumor about an innocent neighbor. Their actions occur naturally within the busy settlement, showing how wrongdoing can become accepted when people stop seeking God. In the foreground, an elderly worshipper stands aside, watching with sadness and reflecting on the psalm's description of people who act as though God does not see. He is not portrayed as morally perfect or superior simply because he is religious. In the distance, a narrow road leads toward a sanctuary on a hill, with a few people beginning to walk that way. The scene should convey the psalm's stark judgment that humanity has turned aside and lacks the understanding it needs, rather than singling out a particular people or social group as uniquely corrupt. Historically plausible garments, market baskets, clay jars, stone buildings, and natural daylight. No modern objects, readable signs, or fantasy imagery.

title: God Is the Refuge of His People
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a vulnerable Israelite household stands near a stone dwelling while powerful men pass through the settlement with dismissive expressions. One man carries away a basket of grain that belongs to a poor neighbor, and another refuses to listen to a plea for fairness. The scene should imply exploitation without showing physical injury. Nearby, faithful families gather at the entrance to a sturdy stone refuge, offering one another food and support while they pray for deliverance. A distant hill evokes Zion, the place associated with the hope that salvation for Israel will come from God and that the fortunes of His people will be restored. The composition should move visually from disorder and intimidation in the foreground toward a gathering marked by mutual care and hope in the background. The wicked are not depicted as monsters; they are ordinary people abusing power. Use historically plausible Israelite clothing, simple grain stores, stone walls, and natural light. No modern objects, graphic violence, captions, or fantasy effects.

title: Save Me by Your Name
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, David takes shelter among rugged hills outside an ancient Israelite settlement after learning that hostile men have revealed his location. He stands near a narrow mountain path and a weathered rock face, holding a staff while raising his face toward the sky in urgent prayer. In the distance, a handful of armed men scan the roads, their figures small against the rocky landscape. David's expression is alert and burdened, but he has not abandoned trust in God. His clothing is practical and travel-worn, with a wool cloak, leather sandals, and a simple belt. A trusted companion watches the path from a safe distance. The scene should express the plea for God to save by His name, hear the prayer, and defend the worshipper against strangers and ruthless people who do not honor God. Avoid depicting a specific attack or claiming the location of the Ziphite betrayal beyond the psalm's heading. Ancient Judean rocks, scrub plants, realistic weapons kept in the background, and natural late-day light. No modern equipment, text, or graphic violence.

title: God Is My Helper
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, David stands on a high rock overlooking a quiet valley as sunlight spreads across the hills. The tense figures who once searched the lower paths have moved farther away, and David now turns toward a small gathering of loyal companions. He bows his head in gratitude, acknowledging God as his helper and the sustainer of his life. Near a stone ledge, he places a modest offering prepared in thanksgiving, emphasizing the psalm's promise to praise God's name because it is good and to offer freely in response to deliverance. Do not show enemies being injured or present the offering as a transaction that purchases divine protection. The atmosphere is one of relief, humility, and trust in God's faithfulness. Behind David, a clear path leads toward a distant Israelite settlement, suggesting renewed freedom to continue his journey. Historically plausible clothing, stone terrain, olive trees, and natural morning light. No modern objects, captions, or fantasy effects.

title: Listen to My Prayer, O God
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, David sits inside a modest stone dwelling in ancient Jerusalem during a moment of intense inner distress. He leans forward with one hand pressed against his chest and the other raised toward the heavens, asking God to hear him because he feels overwhelmed by trouble and the voices of hostile people. A narrow window reveals the crowded streets outside, where several men argue in the distance. A bird lifts from a nearby roof and flies toward the open hills, visually reflecting David's wish to fly away and find rest in the wilderness. The bird should remain an ordinary part of the environment, not a supernatural symbol. David's expression communicates fear, agitation, and longing for relief, while his posture shows that he brings these feelings honestly into prayer. Use realistic oil-lamp lighting, woven bedding, clay vessels, limestone walls, and ancient Israelite clothing. No modern objects, graphic distress, written captions, or fantasy imagery.

title: Violence in the City and Betrayal by a Friend
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an ancient walled city seen from an elevated rooftop at dusk. Below, narrow streets are crowded with quarrels, dishonest bargains, intimidation, and arguments near the city gate. The setting communicates civic disorder and trouble within the walls rather than a battle. In the foreground, David stands beside a low parapet, gazing toward a familiar house across the street. A man who once shared meals and counsel with him now appears in conversation with hostile associates, revealing the emotional force of betrayal by a close companion. David's expression is deeply hurt, not merely angry. A stone stairway descends from the rooftop, but he remains alone at the top for a moment, uncertain how to respond. The composition should distinguish public corruption from the private grief of losing trusted friendship. Use ancient architecture, woven canopies, oil lamps appearing in windows, and realistic human interactions. No modern streetlights, contemporary clothing, graphic violence, or invented readable dialogue.

title: Evening, Morning, and Noon I Will Pray
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, one continuous composition representing the passage of a day in David's life. At the left, he prays at dawn beside a stone wall with pale sunlight touching his face. At the center, he pauses at midday beneath a tree in the courtyard and bows his head in prayer amid the ordinary movement of the household. At the right, he sits beside an oil lamp in the evening, still bringing his concerns to God. A trusted companion may be shown at different points in the background, but the focus remains on David's consistent prayer throughout the day. Distant hostile figures are visible beyond the settlement, emphasizing that prayer continues while opposition persists. The image should also communicate David's distress that words of peace from a former companion concealed conflict in the heart. Keep the three time periods visually connected through the same ancient Israelite setting, realistic light, and changes in shadows. No clocks, written labels, modern furniture, or fantasy effects.

title: Cast Your Burden on the LORD
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, David walks along a stony path through the hills outside Jerusalem, carrying a small travel bag over one shoulder. He pauses beside a natural rock shelter and carefully places the bag on the ground, taking a moment to pray and regain his composure. This ordinary action provides a visual metaphor for casting one's burden upon the LORD without suggesting that prayer instantly removes every difficulty. A companion sits nearby, listening with concern, while the valley beyond remains quiet under a clear sky. In the far distance, the city's walls and gates are still visible, reminding viewers that David's troubles with violence, deceit, and betrayal have not simply disappeared. Nevertheless, his posture is more settled, and he looks ahead with renewed trust that God sustains the righteous. The scene should close the psalm with hope and sober awareness that destructive wrongdoing does not have the final word. Authentic ancient garments, realistic rocks, dry grasses, and natural sunlight. No modern backpacks, captions, or fantasy effects.

title: When I Am Afraid, I Will Trust in You
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, David stands inside a foreign city courtyard associated with his flight to Gath, surrounded by unfamiliar architecture and watchful attendants. His clothing is travel-worn and dusty, and he keeps his hands visible while observing the people around him carefully. Several men speak quietly together in the distance, watching David and discussing his presence. David's expression reveals real fear of being harmed or misrepresented, yet he turns his thoughts toward the LORD and remembers that he will trust in God's word. A narrow doorway opens toward the city streets, offering a glimpse of the uncertain route ahead. This should not portray David as confidently in control; the power of the scene comes from the contrast between vulnerability and trust. Use historically plausible Philistine or coastal Levantine architectural details, ancient garments, wooden doors, and natural light. No modern prison cells, contemporary uniforms, graphic violence, or fantasy effects.

title: You Have Counted My Wanderings
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, David sits near the entrance of a rocky shelter outside an ancient city, exhausted from wandering and the continuing pressure of hostile people. A small waterskin, worn sandals, and a travel cloak lie beside him. He looks toward the hills in prayer, expressing confidence that God has taken account of his wandering and tears and that his cry for help is not forgotten. A clay jar holds a small amount of water, and an ordinary leather pouch rests nearby; no supernatural object is shown. In the distance, David's companions prepare to leave the refuge, while the sky brightens after a long period of uncertain weather. The composition should show that David remains physically vulnerable but no longer wants fear to rule his response. He prepares to continue his journey in gratitude, confident that God has delivered him from death and kept his feet from falling. Historically accurate travel items, rough stone, ancient clothing, and natural morning light. No modern equipment, written captions, or fantasy effects.

title: Under the Shadow of Your Wings
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, David sheltered inside a large natural cave in the hills of Judah while a dangerous storm passes outside. The cave entrance frames the rocky landscape and distant hills, and David sits beneath the stone overhang, praying with his hands gently raised. His trusted companions rest at a safe distance, speaking quietly and keeping watch. Above a nest tucked into a crevice near the cave, a mother bird shelters her young from the wind, creating a small, natural reference to the psalm's imagery of finding refuge under God's wings. David is not shown as an animal or as physically covered by supernatural feathers; the bird is a symbolic detail within a realistic landscape. The stormy sky and jagged rocks convey that his troubles are real, while the cave and his prayerful composure express the hope that God will send help from heaven. Use realistic cave geology, bird anatomy, ancient travel clothing, natural storm light, and detailed stone textures. No modern equipment, fantasy creatures, or written text.

title: My Heart Is Fixed; I Will Sing and Praise
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, David stands at the entrance of a rocky cave as the sun rises over ancient Judah. The path below reveals a concealed pit or snare abandoned in the dust, illustrating the psalm's imagery of enemies falling into a trap they had prepared. No person is shown injured or falling. David looks toward the brightening sky with calm conviction and raises a hand in praise, proclaiming that his heart is steadfast and that he will sing even while dangers have not been forgotten. A companion sits beside a simple lyre and begins to play, while another looks out across the valley. The first rays of sunlight reach the cave walls and nearby hills, symbolizing that God's mercy and truth are higher than the heavens and that His glory fills the earth. Keep the mood triumphant but restrained; this is praise after fear, not a victory parade. Ancient Israelite clothing, realistic instruments, rocky terrain, and natural sunrise. No modern objects, text, or fantasy effects.

title: Are You Speaking Justice?
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a public gathering at the gate of an ancient Israelite town where local judges and influential men hear a dispute. Several powerful men sit on stone benches while a poor petitioner stands before them holding a small bundle of goods and asking for fair treatment. One judge listens impartially, but another exchanges a secretive look with an interested landholder and appears ready to favor the powerful. Nearby, David or a representative worshipper observes with concern and asks whether the authorities truly speak justice and judge uprightly. The scene should visualize the psalm's condemnation of unjust judgment and corruption that begins early in a person's path, without declaring that a particular historical court was involved. A child stands beside the petitioner, watching quietly, while an elder in the crowd shows disapproval of the crooked hearing. Ancient robes, wooden writing boards, stone architecture, and natural light create a realistic civic setting. No modern courtroom furniture, readable documents, graphic violence, or fantasy effects.

title: The Righteous Rejoice in God's Justice
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism with restrained symbolism, a dry valley outside an ancient settlement after a long season of unfair treatment. In the foreground, an elder speaks with a group of ordinary people about the need for justice and the hope that wrongdoing will not continue unchecked. Nearby, a dishonest official's scales sit abandoned on a table, while a concealed basket of unjustly taken goods is returned to its rightful owner. Across the valley, a stream cuts through the earth and continues flowing despite dry ground, suggesting that evil schemes can be brought to an end and that righteous judgment ultimately belongs to God. The psalm contains strong poetic images of dangerous creatures and the destruction of wickedness; do not depict graphic violence or literal divine revenge. Instead, use a broken snare, an empty path, and a clear horizon to communicate the failure of injustice. The people express relief and gratitude that God judges the earth. Historically plausible garments, simple tools, stone terrain, and natural light. No graphic imagery, modern objects, text, or fantasy creatures.

title: Deliver Me from My Enemies
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, David watches from the inside of an ancient house as hostile men gather beyond the city wall. The scene relates to the psalm's heading about Saul sending men to watch David's house and kill him, but no attack is shown. David wears a simple tunic and stands near a narrow window, keeping out of view. A trusted family member quietly prepares a safe route through the back courtyard while a companion listens for footsteps. David turns away from the window and raises his hands in prayer, asking God to deliver him from enemies and violent men despite his claim that he has not committed the wrong they accuse him of. The stone walls, wooden shutters, and narrow passageways should communicate suspense without becoming a modern thriller scene. The hostile men remain outside in the distance, carrying period-appropriate weapons but not threatening a visible victim. Accurate ancient Israelite domestic details, natural low light, realistic expressions. No modern surveillance equipment, graphic violence, or fantasy effects.

title: They Return at Evening, but God Is My Defense
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an ancient Israelite city street at dusk as a small group of hostile men prowls near the outer wall. They move from one alley to another, speaking harshly and looking toward closed doors, like watchful dogs searching for an opportunity. No attack or injury occurs. David remains in a sheltered courtyard behind a thick wooden door, praying and listening while the men pass by outside. An older companion sits near him with a small oil lamp, and a simple lyre rests against the wall, suggesting that prayer and praise will continue through the night. Beyond the city, distant hills are visible under the evening sky. The composition should express David's confidence that God laughs at the schemes of the wicked in the figurative sense of their impotence before divine authority, not as a claim that God is a human spectator. The final emphasis is God as strength, defense, refuge, and steadfast love. Realistic ancient stonework, linen clothing, oil lamps, and dusk light. No modern objects, graphic violence, text, or fantasy creatures.

title: I Will Sing of Your Strength in the Morning
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, the same city courtyard at the first light of morning. David stands in the open space after a night of danger, his expression relieved but alert. The hostile men who had watched the house are no longer prominent in the scene; the streets remain quiet as ordinary residents begin their day. David raises his voice in song while a companion accompanies him on a simple lyre. He gives thanks because the LORD has been his defense and refuge in the day of trouble, and he declares his intention to sing of God's strength and mercy in the morning. A small oil lamp is being extinguished while sunlight enters the courtyard, visually marking the passage from watchful night to grateful morning. The scene should be peaceful without claiming that all future danger has disappeared. Historically plausible Israelite clothing, stone walls, wooden doors, oil lamp, and realistic dawn light. No modern objects, captions, or fantasy effects.

title: Restore Us After Defeat
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an Israelite encampment on a rugged plateau after a military setback. Soldiers sit quietly beside lowered shields and spears, while commanders examine the difficult terrain and discuss the need to regroup. No wounds or dead bodies are shown. David stands apart from the camp with a solemn expression, praying about the feeling that God has rejected or scattered the people and asking for restoration. The earth appears dry and cracked in one part of the landscape, a restrained visual metaphor for the psalm's image of the land trembling and being broken open. In the distance, the hills are veiled by low cloud, while a strip of morning light touches the camp. A simple banner is lowered rather than torn apart, symbolizing uncertainty rather than annihilation. The image should express communal distress and a request for healing and deliverance, without identifying the scene with a specific battlefield beyond the psalm's heading. Ancient Israelite military clothing and equipment, realistic terrain, natural light. No modern military technology or graphic violence.

title: God Has Spoken in His Holiness
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, David stands with his commanders and elders on a high ridge overlooking a broad territory of valleys, fortified towns, and distant mountain passes. An elder unrolls a simple parchment while David gestures toward the landscape, recalling the divine promise and the assurance that the land remains under God's authority. Several soldiers prepare their gear in an orderly manner, but the atmosphere is measured and prayerful rather than boastful. Nearby, a shield and a spear rest against a stone wall, illustrating that human help is vain without God's support. A small group of messengers begins preparing for a journey, signifying renewed resolve to act while depending on the LORD for victory. The distant scenery may suggest regions such as Shechem, Succoth, Gilead, and the surrounding territories mentioned in the psalm, but avoid adding a literal map or arbitrary modern borders. Use historically plausible clothing, ancient weapons, natural terrain, and late-afternoon light. No modern flags, text, or fantasy effects.

title: Lead Me to the Rock That Is Higher Than I
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, David stands at the base of a high rocky outcrop in a remote part of ancient Judah, looking upward toward a narrow ledge that offers shelter from the wind. His face is tired from travel and troubled by distance from his familiar dwelling, but he raises his hands in prayer, asking God to hear his cry from the ends of the land. The massive rock rises above him, clearly higher and more secure than the surrounding rough ground. A trusted companion waits near a sheltered path, and a small travel bag rests on the ground beside David. The landscape extends toward distant hills, conveying remoteness and longing. The rock is a metaphor for divine refuge, not a literal image of God or an invitation to climb dangerously. The composition should express dependence, protection, and the hope of remaining in God's shelter and finding safety under the shadow of His wings. Accurate ancient travel clothing, realistic rock formations, sparse vegetation, and natural soft light. No modern gear, text, or fantasy effects.

title: I Will Sing Praise to Your Name Forever
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an ancient Israelite sanctuary courtyard where worshippers prepare for a solemn celebration. David stands near a simple musical group, listening as a lyre player tests the strings. He expresses gratitude that God has heard his vows and granted him the inheritance of those who fear His name. A royal attendant waits at a respectful distance with a plain ceremonial cloak, suggesting the psalm's prayer for the king's life to be prolonged without presenting a specific coronation or historical event. In the foreground, an elder speaks with a child about faithfulness and daily worship. The sanctuary is modest and historically grounded, with stone paving, woven curtains, wooden beams, and clay lamps. The mood is peaceful and enduring, conveying David's desire to abide before God forever and sing praise from day to day. Use authentic ancient clothing, realistic musical instruments, and natural daylight. No modern instruments, microphones, printed music, or fantasy effects.

title: My Soul Waits Silently for God
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, David sits quietly on a stone ledge overlooking a broad valley outside ancient Jerusalem. The sky is open and the morning is calm, contrasting with several hostile men who stand farther down the slope, whispering together and preparing to spread accusations. One man gestures toward David with a dismissive expression, while another looks toward the city as if considering how to undermine a person who stands firm. David does not turn to confront them; his gaze remains steady as he waits for God, his rock, salvation, and stronghold. A small walking staff lies beside him, and the path under his feet is stable, reinforcing the image of a person who will not be greatly shaken. Keep the emotional tone meditative, with a sense of quiet endurance rather than passivity or fear. Ancient Israelite robes, limestone cliffs, sparse vegetation, realistic morning light. No modern objects, readable text, or fantasy imagery.

title: Trust in Him at All Times
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a small community gathers on a broad stone terrace in ancient Israel. David stands in the center, calmly teaching the people to pour out their hearts before God because He is their refuge. Around him are families, laborers, elders, and travelers, each showing a different expression of concern or relief. One man speaks about an uncertain harvest; a widow holds a small basket; a young traveler listens intently. David gestures toward a sturdy rocky ridge beyond the village, using its physical stability as a visual metaphor for God as the rock of salvation and honor. Nearby, a wealthy merchant stands beside his goods, while an elder reminds him through gesture and conversation that neither wealth nor human power should become a false refuge. The image should communicate collective trust and truthful prayer rather than implying that everyone has already received a particular answer. Authentic ancient garments, stone walls, woven baskets, and natural afternoon light. No modern architecture, currency, text, or fantasy effects.

title: Power Belongs to God
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a public gathering in an ancient Israelite town where people from different circumstances stand together near the city gate. A wealthy landholder wears fine robes and carries a small pouch, while a laborer in plain clothing stands beside him, visibly equal in human dignity. Beyond them, a group of influential men exchange secretive words, revealing the temptation to trust oppression, robbery, or accumulated riches. David addresses the gathering with calm seriousness, encouraging them not to set their hearts on wealth even when it increases and reminding them that true power and steadfast love belong to God. A stone balance scale rests on a nearby market table, symbolizing the need for honest judgment. The scene must not portray every rich person as wicked or every poor person as righteous; it should stress that neither status nor dishonest gain can replace God's authority. Historically plausible clothing, ancient market goods, stone architecture, and warm daylight. No modern banknotes, written slogans, or fantasy effects.

title: My Soul Thirsts for You in a Dry Land
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, David wanders through a dry wilderness in ancient Judah, surrounded by dusty ground, low thorn bushes, and rugged limestone ridges. He pauses beside a shallow watercourse that has almost dried up, with only a few small pools remaining between the stones. His face reveals physical thirst and spiritual longing as he seeks God earnestly, recalling the sanctuary and the sight of God's power and glory. One hand shades his eyes from the sun while the other rests against his chest in prayer. A small group of companions follows at a distance, carrying simple travel supplies. The landscape should feel dry but inhabited, with occasional hardy plants and distant birds, not like an endless sand desert foreign to Judah. The image should express the deep desire for God as more precious than life itself and the satisfaction of praising Him, not suggest that bodily thirst alone is the psalm's meaning. Historically accurate travel clothing, realistic terrain, natural harsh sunlight. No modern water bottles, equipment, captions, or fantasy effects.

title: My Soul Follows Close After You
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a quiet night watch in the wilderness of ancient Judah. David sits beneath a rocky overhang with a simple woven cloak around his shoulders, looking up at a sky filled with stars. A small oil lamp glows on the ground beside him, and his companions rest nearby after a long day's travel. David's hands are raised slightly in prayer, expressing remembrance of God during the night watches and rejoicing under the shadow of His wings. A narrow path leads away from the camp through the rugged terrain, symbolizing his soul following closely after God while divine support sustains him. Far in the distance, a few indistinct figures move along another ridge, suggesting the continuing threat of enemies without showing any confrontation. The scene's final feeling should be confident hope in God, whose justice will overcome falsehood. Use realistic night lighting, ancient garments, rocky Judean landscape, and natural stars. No modern tents, artificial lighting, written captions, or fantasy effects.
